note: Dexter, on the banks of the Black River at Black River Bay, near Lake Ontario and the Thousand Islands. ~100 sites (~60 seasonal) with nightly transient sites; boat ramp, dockage. --Claude
summary: Confirmed the 2026 rates ($45 W/E, $50 full hookup, water-view or waterfront W/E; monthly $495 + electric, seasonal $2,050 + electric), 20/30/50-amp with water and sewer, pull-throughs, Wi-Fi, dump and pump-out, phone/form reservations. Fees left as stored (2026-10-16). Note trimmed of field facts. Home page: 'We are closed for the season, see you in the Spring!' (seasonal close, not a status). Not stated: season dates (left derived 05-01..10-15), site count/seasonal share (left derived 100), site lengths.
